_doc: Items. 'effects' use the shared effect keys handled by src/core/systems/effects.gd (qi, alignment, items, breakthrough_bonus, set_flag, learn_technique, heal_injury, learn_recipe, burn_lifespan, extend_lifespan, buff, bloodline). price is in spirit stones; 0 = not sold. tags (optional) group items: 'herb' and 'ore' are gathering materials, sold only by merchants that stock those tags, and merchants buy them back at half price (crafted items, i.e. recipe outputs, at most at their material cost times recipes.json alchemy.crafted_sell_markup). equip (optional) makes an item equipment (Equipment system): {slot: weapon|armor, grade: int >= 1, stats: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: flat bonus}, lifespan_drain (optional int years burned after every fight fought while it is equipped; evil artifacts)}; using it equips it. Equipment is tagged equipment (sold only by merchants that stock that tag). Forging manuals (learn_recipe for blacksmith recipes) are tagged smithing and sold by smithies. Talismans (tag talisman, every one needs a talisman_master recipe) are single-use items inscribed by Talisman Masters; most grant a temporary combat buff via the buff effect {id, name, days, mults: {attack|defense|max_hp|speed: fraction}}. combat (optional, CombatTalismans) makes a talisman one the player can ready for fights instead of using it: {kind: strike (opening damage) | shield (absorbs damage) | escape (turns a defeat into a flight), grade: 1 = mortal power, 2 = Qi Refining, ... (each grade multiplies power like a major realm), power: damage or shield at grade 1 (not needed for escape)}; one of each readied talisman is burned per fight. Tag inscription marks talisman supplies and talisman manuals (sold by talisman stalls). Tag blood_art marks blood-path pills and manuals: only merchants that stock blood_art (the Blood Lotus Apothecary) sell them, not general stores.

items.name: Blank Talisman Paper
items.description: Yellow paper soaked in cinnabar ink, ready to hold a spell.

items.name: Golden Bell Talisman
items.description: Burn it to wrap yourself in a faint golden bell of qi that turns aside blows.

items.name: Swift Wind Talisman
items.description: A wind rune that lightens your body for days.

items.name: Vermilion Flame Talisman
items.description: Fire qi sealed in vermilion script. It sets your strikes ablaze for a few days.

items.name: Fire Strike Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: it bursts into a fist of flame at the first exchange.

items.name: Earth Wall Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: a shell of earth qi takes the blows meant for you.

items.name: Thousand-Li Escape Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: if you are about to fall, it tears you away on a gust of wind.

items.name: Jade Vitality Talisman
items.description: A green rune that steeps your flesh in wood qi, hardening it against death.

items.name: Spirit Stone
items.description: Crystallized qi. The currency of cultivators.

items.name: Qi Gathering Pill
items.description: A common pill that floods the meridians with qi.

items.name: Superior Qi Gathering Pill
items.description: A flawless, pale-gold Qi Gathering Pill with almost no impurities.

items.name: Flawless Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: A pill bearing a faint cloud pattern. Far better odds at your next major breakthrough.

items.name: Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: Greatly improves the odds of your next major breakthrough.

items.name: Bone-Setting Salve
items.description: A pungent salve that knits broken bones overnight.

items.name: Meridian Mending Pill
items.description: Soothes qi deviation and calms wild meridians.

items.name: Jade Marrow Pill
items.description: A precious pill that heals every injury of body and meridian.

items.name: Spirit Gathering Pill
items.description: A richer pill that draws dense qi into the dantian. Favoured by late Qi Refining cultivators.

items.name: Visceral Mending Pill
items.description: A warm, bitter pill that knits torn organs after a hard fight.

items.name: Meridian Rebuilding Pill
items.description: Coaxes shattered meridians to regrow, strand by strand.

items.name: Clear Heart Pill
items.description: Quiets the mind and washes away killing intent. Righteous alchemists swear by it.

items.name: Blood Demon Pill
items.description: A forbidden pill refined from blood and ginseng. It floods the meridians with power and stains the heart.

items.name: Core Forming Pill
items.description: A legendary pill that steadies the dantian while a golden core coalesces.

items.name: Spirit Herb
items.description: A common herb steeped in qi. Chew it to refine a little energy.

items.name: Blood Ginseng
items.description: A centuries-old root, rich enough to steady a breakthrough.

items.name: Ancient Jade Slip
items.description: A long-dead cultivator's insights into the Dao, sealed in jade.

items.name: Morning Dew Grass
items.description: A common herb that holds a drop of qi in each blade.

items.name: Qi Condensing Grass
items.description: The main ingredient of Qi Gathering Pills.

items.name: Purple Cloud Mushroom
items.description: Grows on rotting spirit wood in deep mist. Calms the meridians.

items.name: Flame Lotus
items.description: A fire-attribute lotus that blooms only where earth-fire vents.

items.name: Ice Soul Flower
items.description: A frost-white flower from high peaks. Clears the mind before a breakthrough.

items.name: Thousand-Year Lingzhi
items.description: A legendary fungus. Alchemists would kill for one.

items.name: Iron Essence
items.description: Iron ore with a trace of qi. Used by every apprentice smith.

items.name: Cold Iron
items.description: Ore that stays cold even in a forge. Takes a keen edge.

items.name: Azure Crystal
items.description: A crystal grown in qi-rich mountain veins. Prized by array masters.

items.name: Star Silver
items.description: Metal from a fallen star. Rare and sought after for artifacts.

items.name: Profound Iron
items.description: Dense black iron that will not soften in a mortal fire. Only a Foundation cultivator's forge-flame can work it.

items.name: Dragon-Blood Gold
items.description: Red-veined gold said to have formed where an ancient dragon bled into the mountain. Warm to the touch and fiercely sought by master smiths.

items.name: Manual: Basic Breathing Method
items.description: A dog-eared pamphlet. Teaches the Basic Breathing Method.

items.name: Manual: Blood Demon Rage
items.description: A scripture written in dried blood. Teaches the forbidden Blood Demon Rage, which burns years of life for power.

items.name: Manual: Blood Shadow Flight
items.description: A furtive pamphlet sold from under the counter. Teaches Blood Shadow Flight, which burns 5 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Ten-Thousand Bones Armor
items.description: Bound in cured skin and stitched with hair. Teaches Ten-Thousand Bones Armor, which burns 15 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Heaven-Devouring Burst
items.description: The pages hum with hunger. Teaches Heaven-Devouring Burst, which burns 40 years of life per use.

items.name: Manual: Iron Fist
items.description: Crude drawings of punches. Teaches Iron Fist.

items.name: Manual: Stone Skin Tempering
items.description: A body-tempering regimen carved on a slate. Teaches Stone Skin Tempering.

items.name: Manual: Verdant Spring Method
items.description: A wood-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a wood root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Ember Heart Method
items.description: A fire-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a fire root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Still Lake Method
items.description: A water-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a water root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Iron Marrow Method
items.description: A metal-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with a metal root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Deep Loam Method
items.description: An earth-element main cultivation method (faster qi gathering, best with an earth root). Good up to Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Azure Cloud Heart Sutra
items.description: The Azure Cloud Sect's water-element main method, good through Core Formation. Only the sect hands it out, for contribution.

items.name: Manual: Golden Abacus Method
items.description: The Myriad Treasure Pavilion's metal-element main method, good through Core Formation. Only the Pavilion hands it out, for contribution.

items.name: Manual: Blood Lotus Rebirth Scripture
items.description: The Blood Lotus Sect's fire-element main method, good through Core Formation. Learning it stains the heart.

items.name: Manual: Mountain-and-Sea Breathing Art
items.description: A hermit's earth-element main method, good through Core Formation.

items.name: Manual: Nine Heavens Thunder Scripture
items.description: A lost sect's main method for any root, good through Nascent Soul. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Myriad Corpse Devouring Canon
items.description: A demonic main method for any root, good through Nascent Soul. Requires Foundation Establishment. Learning it stains the heart.

items.name: Manual: Flowing Water Sutra
items.description: A water-element cultivation method. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Blazing Sun Art
items.description: A fire-element cultivation method. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Metal Edge Sword Art
items.description: A metal-element sword art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Drifting Wind Step
items.description: A wood-element movement art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Cloud-Parting Palm
items.description: A neatly copied sect primer, the kind outer disciples sell when short of stones. Teaches a water-element palm art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Burning Cinder Fist
items.description: Scorch marks on every page. Teaches a fire-element fist art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Verdant Vine Lash
items.description: Written on pressed leaves bound with vine. Teaches a wood-element whip art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Immovable Mountain Stance
items.description: Stance diagrams carved into a slab of mountain stone. Teaches an earth-element body art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Golden Bell Shield
items.description: A sutra gifted by grateful monks. Teaches a metal-element body art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Scarlet Blood Palm
items.description: The pages are stiff with old blood. Teaches a demonic palm art. Requires Qi Refining.

items.name: Manual: Nine Frost Sword Intent
items.description: A jade slip so cold it frosts your fingers. Teaches a water-element sword art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Five Thunders Palm
items.description: A Daoist treatise sealed with a thunder talisman. Teaches a fire-element palm art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Thousand Fallen Leaves Step
items.description: Footwork charts that seem to shift when you look away. Teaches a wood-element movement art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Earth Dragon Body
items.description: Rubbings taken from a dragon-vein stele. Teaches an earth-element body art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Corpse Qi Claw
items.description: Wrapped in burial silk and smelling of the grave. Teaches a demonic claw art. Requires Foundation Establishment.

items.name: Manual: Azure Heaven Sword Canon
items.description: A sword-shaped jade slip humming with ancient intent. Teaches a metal-element sword canon. Requires Core Formation.

items.name: Manual: Soul-Rending Demon Finger
items.description: A black bone slip that whispers when held. Teaches a demonic finger art. Requires Core Formation.

items.name: Blood Essence Burning Pill
items.description: A forbidden pill that ignites your own blood essence: a flood of qi, paid for with years of your life.

items.name: Longevity Pill
items.description: A legendary pill that knits fresh years onto a cultivator's life.

items.name: Celestial Fox Essence Blood
items.description: A drop of silver blood shed by a fox spirit on its way to heaven. Drinking it plants the Nine-Tailed Fox Bloodline in one who has none.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Meridian Mending Pill
items.description: An alchemist's notes on calming wild meridians. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Foundation Establishment Pill
items.description: A guarded formula, copied in a careful hand. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Jade Marrow Pill
items.description: A brittle scroll from a lost alchemy lineage. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Spirit Gathering Pill
items.description: Notes on doubling the potency of a common pill. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Visceral Mending Pill
items.description: A field medic's formula for internal wounds. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Meridian Rebuilding Pill
items.description: A sect elder's refinement of the mending formula. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Clear Heart Pill
items.description: A temple recipe, copied by a monk's steady hand. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Blood Demon Pill
items.description: A blood-spotted scroll that circulates only in dark markets. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Core Forming Pill
items.description: A treasured formula that few alchemists ever see. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A plain sword of qi-tempered iron. Better than bare fists.

items.name: Iron Scale Armor
items.description: Overlapping iron scales sewn onto leather.

items.name: Cold Iron Saber
items.description: A frost-edged saber that bites through hide and bone.

items.name: Flawless Cold Iron Saber
items.description: A masterwork saber without a single impurity. Frost mist trails its edge.

items.name: Blood-Drinker Saber
items.description: A crimson demonic saber that hungers for life. Its power is immense, but every battle it drinks a year of its wielder's lifespan.

items.name: Azure Guard Robe
items.description: A robe woven with star silver thread and azure crystal plates. Turns aside blades and qi alike.

items.name: Gold-Thread Talisman Paper
items.description: Spirit-silk paper threaded with gold and soaked in beast-blood cinnabar. It can hold a Foundation cultivator's script without burning up.

items.name: Vajra Diamond Talisman
items.description: A Buddhist seal in golden script. Burned, it hardens your body like a temple guardian's for a week.

items.name: Thunder God Talisman
items.description: Purple lightning crackles inside the paper. For three days your every strike carries the wrath of heaven.

items.name: Ghost Shadow Talisman
items.description: A grey rune that thins your shadow until you move like a wandering ghost.

items.name: Blood Sacrifice Talisman
items.description: Written in a living victim's heart-blood. Burning it fills you with savage strength, and stains your Dao heart a little more.

items.name: Five Thunder Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: five bolts of lightning fall on your foe at the first exchange.

items.name: Black Tortoise Shell Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: the phantom shell of the Black Tortoise closes around you.

items.name: Heaven-Splitting Sword Talisman
items.description: Ready it before a fight: a sword intent sealed by a Core Formation sword cultivator, enough to cleave a hill in two.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Vajra Diamond Talisman
items.description: A temple monk's copybook of golden seal script. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Thunder God Talisman
items.description: Strokes copied from a thunder-struck stele. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Ghost Shadow Talisman
items.description: A thin booklet that seems to vanish when you look away. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Five Thunder Talisman
items.description: The Five Thunder rites of a Daoist lineage. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Black Tortoise Shell Talisman
items.description: Diagrams of the northern guardian's shell, drawn in black ink. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Heaven-Splitting Sword Talisman
items.description: A sword cultivator's last testament, how to fold sword intent into paper. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Talisman Manual: Blood Sacrifice Talisman
items.description: A demonic manual bound in human skin. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Corpse-Silk Burial Armor
items.description: A burial shroud woven from the silk of corpse-eating spiders, still cold from the coffin. Blades slide off it, but each battle it wraps tighter and draws a year of life from its wearer.

items.name: Myriad Souls Banner
items.description: A black banner in which ten thousand slaughtered souls howl. Waved in battle it tears through flesh and qi alike, and every fight it feeds them two years of its bearer's life.

items.name: Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A long spear of black profound iron. Its weight alone can shatter a Qi Refining cultivator's guard.

items.name: Flawless Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A masterwork spear whose tip never dulls. A faint dragon-roar follows each thrust.

items.name: Profound Iron Lamellar
items.description: Hundreds of profound iron plates laced with spirit silk. Heavy, but it turns aside sword qi.

items.name: Star River Sword
items.description: A blade of star silver folded with dragon-blood gold. Swung at night, it leaves a trail like the Milky Way.

items.name: Vermilion Dragon Scale Armor
items.description: Scales of dragon-blood gold set over star silver mail. It glows red when struck, as if the dragon still lives.

items.name: Forging Manual: Profound Iron Spear
items.description: A smith's notes on tempering profound iron without cracking it. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Profound Iron Lamellar
items.description: Diagrams for lacing iron plates with spirit silk. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Star River Sword
items.description: A master smith's secret for folding star silver with dragon-blood gold. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Forging Manual: Vermilion Dragon Scale Armor
items.description: A jade slip pressed with the forging memories of an ancient dragon-hunting smith. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Cloud-Mist Orchid
items.description: A hundred-year orchid that only opens inside the cloud sea. Its petals are half qi, half mist.

items.name: Scarlet Flame Fruit
items.description: A fist-sized fruit ripened over an earth-fire vent for a century. Too hot to eat raw.

items.name: Hundred-Year Snow Lotus
items.description: A snow lotus that has seen a hundred winters. Chewing a petal chills the meridians clean.

items.name: Earth Marrow Fungus
items.description: A pale fungus fed by the marrow of the earth, deep in old mountain roots. Heavy as stone.

items.name: Nine-Leaf Soul Grass
items.description: A grass that grows one leaf per hundred years. At nine leaves it nourishes the soul itself.

items.name: Golden Core Lotus Seed
items.description: The seed of a thousand-year lotus, round and golden like a formed core. Core Formation alchemists fight over them.

items.name: Earth-Vein Jade
items.description: Green jade threaded with veins of condensed earth qi. Steadies arrays and forges alike.

items.name: Fire Marrow Crystal
items.description: A red crystal that formed where a fallen star burned into the ground. It never cools.

items.name: Cloud-Mist Qi Pill
items.description: A misty-white pill that pours a season of cultivation into a Foundation cultivator's dantian.

items.name: Soul Nourishing Pill
items.description: Warms and steadies the soul so it does not crack under the pressure of a breakthrough.

items.name: Earth Marrow Essence Pill
items.description: A heavy golden pill that feeds a formed core like a river feeds a lake.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Cloud-Mist Qi Pill
items.description: An Azure Cloud outer-court formula, copied many times. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Soul Nourishing Pill
items.description: A jade slip humming with a dead alchemist's calm. Teaches the recipe.

items.name: Recipe Scroll: Earth Marrow Essence Pill
items.description: A heavy stone tablet carved by a Core Formation alchemist. Teaches the recipe.
